verdict.rationale: Model failover is a fair question for a self-hostable multi-provider chat platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only multi-provider support (Azure OpenAI and Ollama integrations, new model additions such as Gemini and Kimi). It never documents automatic fallback to another provider or model when a request errors or is rate-limited. Supporting several providers is an adjacent capability and does not count as failover.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
